preflight.query:
select jsonb_build_object(
 'observed_at',now(),
 'history',(select jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'latest',max(version),'pending_record_count',count(*) filter(where version in ('20260928164743','20260929004448'))) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations),
 'relations',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',c.relname,'estimated_rows',c.reltuples,'table_bytes',pg_table_size(c.oid),'total_bytes',pg_total_relation_size(c.oid),'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,'authenticated_table_update',has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'UPDATE'),'acl',c.relacl::text) order by c.relname) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('communication_rooms','communication_room_memberships')),
 'ownership_columns',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'authenticated_update',has_column_privilege('authenticated',a.attrelid,a.attnum,'UPDATE'))),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid='public.communication_room_memberships'::regclass and a.attname in ('membership_generation','membership_admission_attempt') and not a.attisdropped),
 'triggers',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',t.tgrelid::regclass::text,'name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid)) order by t.tgrelid::regclass::text,t.tgname) from pg_trigger t where t.tgrelid in ('public.communication_rooms'::regclass,'public.communication_room_memberships'::regclass) and not t.tgisinternal),
 'partial_new_functions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex'))),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('public','private') and p.proname in ('advance_communication_membership_generation','guard_owned_communication_membership_write','leave_communication_room_session','authorize_communication_room_admission_internal','read_communication_room_admission','join_communication_room_owned','broadcast_communication_state_invalidation')),
 'policies',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',tablename,'name',policyname,'command',cmd,'roles',roles,'using',qual,'with_check',with_check) order by tablename,policyname) from pg_policies where schemaname='public' and tablename in ('communication_rooms','communication_room_memberships')),
 'publications',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('publication',pubname,'table',tablename)),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_publication_tables where schemaname='public' and tablename in ('communication_rooms','communication_room_memberships')),
 'current_realtime_partitions',(select count(*) from pg_inherits i join pg_class p on p.oid=i.inhparent join pg_namespace pn on pn.oid=p.relnamespace where pn.nspname='realtime' and p.relname='messages'),
 'target_lock_activity',(select jsonb_build_object('held',count(*) filter(where granted),'waiting',count(*) filter(where not granted)) from pg_locks where relation in ('public.communication_rooms'::regclass,'public.communication_room_memberships'::regclass)),
 'long_transactions',(select jsonb_build_object('over_60s',count(*) filter(where now()-xact_start>interval '60 seconds'),'oldest_seconds',coalesce(max(extract(epoch from now()-xact_start)),0)) from pg_stat_activity where datname=current_database() and pid<>pg_backend_pid() and xact_start is not null)
) as preflight;

policies.name: communication_room_memberships_host_update_policy
policies.using:
(whole_app_exact_current_session_authority() AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM communication_rooms room
  WHERE ((room.room_id = communication_room_memberships.room_id) AND (room.host_user_id = (auth.uid())::text)))))
policies.with_check:
(whole_app_exact_current_session_authority() AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM communication_rooms room
  WHERE ((room.room_id = communication_room_memberships.room_id) AND (room.host_user_id = (auth.uid())::text)))))

policies.name: communication_rooms_insert_policy
policies.with_check:
((host_user_id = (auth.uid())::text) AND whole_app_exact_current_session_authority() AND (NOT is_account_access_restricted((auth.uid())::text)) AND (room_id = upper(btrim(room_id))) AND (room_code = room_id) AND (status = 'active'::text) AND (((linked_party_id IS NULL) AND (linked_room_code IS NULL) AND (linked_room_mode IS NULL)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM watch_party_rooms linked_party
  WHERE ((linked_party.party_id = communication_rooms.linked_party_id) AND (linked_party.party_id = communication_rooms.linked_room_code) AND ((linked_party.host_user_id)::text = (auth.uid())::text) AND linked_party.is_active AND can_read_watch_party_room_authority(linked_party.party_id))))))

triggers.name: enforce_communication_membership_identity
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER enforce_communication_membership_identity BEFORE UPDATE ON public.communication_room_memberships FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_communication_membership_identity()

triggers.name: enforce_communication_room_memberships_account_access_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER enforce_communication_room_memberships_account_access_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.communication_room_memberships FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_communication_room_memberships_account_access_guard()

triggers.name: prevent_ended_communication_room_membership_reactivation
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER prevent_ended_communication_room_membership_reactivation BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF membership_state, camera_enabled, mic_enabled ON public.communication_room_memberships FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION prevent_ended_communication_room_membership_reactivation()

triggers.name: enforce_communication_room_identity
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER enforce_communication_room_identity BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.communication_rooms FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_communication_room_identity()

triggers.name: enforce_communication_rooms_abuse_guard
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER enforce_communication_rooms_abuse_guard BEFORE INSERT ON public.communication_rooms FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_communication_rooms_abuse_guard()

triggers.name: enforce_livekit_room_namespace_unique_trigger
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER enforce_livekit_room_namespace_unique_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF room_id ON public.communication_rooms FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reserve_livekit_room_namespace()

triggers.name: release_livekit_room_namespace_trigger
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER release_livekit_room_namespace_trigger AFTER DELETE ON public.communication_rooms FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION release_livekit_room_namespace()

queries.sql: select p.oid::regprocedure::text as signature, p.proname, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as identity_args, md5(p.prosrc) as body_md5, p.prosecdef as security_definer, p.proconfig, has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as anon_execute, has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as authenticated_execute, has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE') as service_role_execute from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('join_communication_room_session','broadcast_communication_room_signal','assert_account_private_feature_allowed','can_access_chat_thread','can_access_communication_realtime_topic','can_read_communication_room_authority','can_read_watch_party_room_authority','communication_sdp_is_receive_only_internal','has_channel_audience_block_between','is_account_access_restricted','user_has_active_entitlement','whole_app_exact_current_session_authority_internal','resolve_paid_watch_party_ticket_access','watch_party_room_self_access_allowed_internal') order by p.proname,signature;

rows.identity_args: p_room_id text, p_event text, p_payload jsonb
p_room_id text, p_display_name text, p_avatar_url text, p_camera_enabled boolean, p_mic_enabled boolean

queries.sql: select p.oid::regprocedure::text as signature, pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) as arguments_with_defaults, pg_get_function_result(p.oid) as result_type, pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) as owner, p.provolatile, p.proparallel, p.proleakproof, p.proacl::text as acl from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('join_communication_room_session','broadcast_communication_room_signal') order by signature;

rows.arguments_with_defaults: p_room_id text, p_event text, p_payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
p_room_id text, p_display_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_avatar_url text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_camera_enabled boolean DEFAULT false, p_mic_enabled boolean DEFAULT true

queries.sql: select p.oid::regprocedure::text as signature, md5(p.prosrc) as body_md5, md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) as definition_md5, p.prosecdef as security_definer, p.proconfig, position('ticket_blocked_sold_out' in p.prosrc) > 0 as has_projector_capacity_path, position('grants_livekit_publish' in p.prosrc) > 0 as has_legacy_metadata_flag, position('payout_access' in p.prosrc) > 0 as has_safe_payout_flag from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('admin_revoke_money_access_grant_for_proof','sync_paid_watch_party_ticket_from_access_grant','prevent_paid_watch_party_ticket_oversell') order by signature;

select t.tgname, t.tgenabled, t.tgtype, p.oid::regprocedure::text as function_signature, md5(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid)) as trigger_definition_md5 from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace join pg_proc p on p.oid=t.tgfoid where not t.tgisinternal and n.nspname='public' and c.relname='paid_watch_party_tickets' order by t.tgname;

select p.oid::regprocedure::text as signature, md5(p.prosrc) as body_md5, p.prosecdef as security_definer, p.proconfig from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('can_read_watch_party_room_authority','resolve_paid_watch_party_ticket_access','resolve_paid_watch_party_ticket_access_pre_integrity_closeout') order by signature;

completeNewObjectInventory.query:
select jsonb_build_object(
'observed_at',now(),
'new_functions',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',p.proname,'signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'definition_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex'))),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where (n.nspname='public' and p.proname in ('advance_communication_membership_generation','guard_owned_communication_membership_write','leave_communication_room_session','authorize_communication_room_admission_internal','read_communication_room_admission','join_owned_communication_room_session','touch_owned_communication_room_session','broadcast_communication_room_signal_internal','broadcast_owned_communication_room_signal')) or (n.nspname='private' and p.proname='broadcast_communication_state_invalidation')),
'new_triggers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',t.tgname,'table',t.tgrelid::regclass::text,'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid))),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_trigger t where not t.tgisinternal and t.tgname in ('zz_advance_communication_membership_generation','aa_guard_owned_communication_membership_write','broadcast_communication_room_state_invalidation','broadcast_communication_membership_state_invalidation')),
'new_columns',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod))),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid='public.communication_room_memberships'::regclass and a.attname in ('membership_generation','membership_admission_attempt') and not a.attisdropped),
'pending_history',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('version',version,'name',name)),'[]'::jsonb) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where version in ('20260928164743','20260929004448'))
) as inventory;

realtimeCatalogPreflight.query: select jsonb_build_object('observed_at',now(),'send_function',(select jsonb_build_object('signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'definition_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex')) from pg_proc p where p.oid=to_regprocedure('realtime.send(jsonb,text,text,boolean)')),'message_partition_bounds',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'bound',pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound,c.oid)) order by c.relname) from pg_inherits i join pg_class p on p.oid=i.inhparent join pg_namespace pn on pn.oid=p.relnamespace join pg_class c on c.oid=i.inhrelid where pn.nspname='realtime' and p.relname='messages')) as realtime_preflight;
